# WSL2 configuration of the host machine during the run.
# Copied verbatim from .wslconfig. This is what capped the pipeline at 6 CPUs
# and ~12 GB of RAM, and therefore what made the run take months of wall clock.

[wsl2]
memory=12GB      # Límite de RAM para WSL
processors=6     # Número de núcleos a usar (tu i5-1240P tiene 12 hilos, 6 es razonable)
swap=8GB         # Tamaño del archivo swap
localhostForwarding=true
